slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
disgustingly intelligent

word origins

learn one latin or ancient greek word a day and where it ended up in english. suddenly half the words you use start explaining themselves.

one room museum

go to a museum alone and spend 20 minutes in a single room. rushing through everything is how people see a lot and remember nothing.

other side writing

pick a debate you have an opinion on and write the best case for the other side. people who can do this are the hardest to fool.

five minutes of science

spend 5 minutes a day on one science question: why we dream, how stars die, what time actually is. the questions get stranger, and your thinking gets sharper.
slides.texte_sophia:
five minutes of science

spend 5 minutes a day on one big question: why we dream, how stars die. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app explains it simply, and your thinking gets sharper every week.

slides.texte_overlay:
question walks

go for a walk with one question in your head and no music. your best thinking shows up when you stop feeding your brain other people's thoughts.
